Character Identities:
Woman 1: A fictional adult Japanese woman, 22 years old, 4th-year computer science student. Height 168 cm, with long legs and good posture, naturally and realistically glamorous figure. Maintains natural weight and width proportionate to her ribcage, realistic waist, and pelvis and hips proportionate to her legs. No push-up or exaggeration of body parts. Slightly vertically-elongated heart-shaped face, high cheekbones, slender jaw, subtle hooding with horizontally elongated almond eyes, slightly upturned outer eye corners, high-arched eyebrows, slender straight nose with a sharp tip, full lips. Tan-free fair neutral skin, one small mole high on her right cheek. Long layered black hair, completely straight down to below the chest. Honey-brown eyes, thin winged eyeliner, coral-beige lips, thin gold hoops. Characterized by a confident toothy smile, but prioritizing the specified expression for this scene rather than repeating the same expression.
Woman 2: A fictional adult Japanese woman, 30 years old, bakery cafe manager. Height 166 cm with long legs, healthy and realistic hourglass figure. Maintains natural weight and width proportionate to her ribcage, realistic waist, slightly rounded hips with a natural transition from pelvis to upper thighs. No extreme narrow waist, spherical breasts, or exaggerated hips. Compact rounded oval face, soft cheeks and rounded chin, large double-lidded almond-to-round dark brown eyes, very subtle droop at outer corners, soft arched eyebrows, natural nasal bridge with a rounded tip, full lips. Fair warm-neutral skin, faint freckles across the nose, small mole under her left outer eye corner, dimples on both cheeks when smiling. Shoulder-length straight layered bob; crown, roots, surface, and bangs are black to dark charcoal. Smoky gray is only on the inner layer around the ears and lower tips. No middle part or gray surface hair. Taupe eye makeup, rose-beige lips, thin silver hoops. Round, thin black-rimmed glasses. Alive expression fitting the situation.
Woman 3: A fictional adult Japanese woman, 23 years old, nail technician. Petite 152 cm with a soft adult figure, natural build, realistic shoulders and ribcage, waist, proportionate pelvis and hips, adult limb proportions. Small round face, large dark brown droopy eyes, short straight parallel eyebrows, small nose, soft lips, fair neutral skin, one small mole under her right eye. Glossy black semi-long hair in low twintails. Dusty pink is only on the inner layer of the lower ends; crown and roots are black. Adult-appropriate pink-toned eye makeup without white face paint. Characterized by a shy, closed-mouth smile. Applies the specified styling: hair partially tied up in the morning, and untied after returning home. Not a minor, no school uniforms, no cosplay.
Do not mix up the three women's faces, ages, hair, figures, moles, outfits, or belongings. Do not give all three the same pose of tilting their heads and smiling. Do not depict the petite Woman 3 as a child. Maintain the described faces and physiques, without commercial surface retouches.

Scene: Walking on Enoshima Island
Inside Enoshima Island, at a rest area overlooking the ocean after walking up a slope. Stone borders, greenery, and the ocean in the background. The candid moment a photo was taken by a tourist before the three could align their poses. On the left, Woman 1 stretches out one arm pointing toward the background view, her mouth open as she talks to her friends. In the center, Woman 2 holds a plain cold drink with a lid in one hand, offering it to Woman 3 on the right, looking at her with a soft expression. Woman 3 has not yet taken it; she holds the handles of a large tote bag with both hands, lightly puffing her cheeks as she catches her breath. Each person has a different head angle and gaze direction. Shot on a smartphone standard 1x lens, photographer at about 2 meters distance, chest height, framed from the waist up to include hands and drinks. All three are at roughly the same depth, with AF locked near the face of Woman 2 in the center. Daytime natural light, wind gently moving hair and fabric. The far background is soft; no text or extraneous prominent figures.

Outfits:
Woman 1 wears a white, fitted, opaque sleeveless top and blue denim shorts, comfortable white walking sneakers, thin gold hoops, and a smartwatch. Woman 2 wears a charcoal opaque sleeveless top and thin black wide-leg trousers, flat sandals, thin silver hoops, and round black-rimmed glasses. Woman 3 wears a black opaque sleeveless top with a small ribbon, dusty pink culottes, and comfortable black walking sandals.

Composition:
Landscape 3:2, a single continuous photograph. All three share the same space together. No splits, collages, frames, names, or text. The main subjects are only the three: Woman 1, Woman 2, and Woman 3.

Fixed Photorealistic Quality:
A near-raw, standalone HEIC photo taken with a standard smartphone camera app. No portrait mode, beauty filters, face-only relighting, exposure correction, re-sharpening, noise reduction, or skin smoothing. AF is placed only on the single plane specified in the camera section, making that plane naturally the sharpest, while people, limbs, props, and background in front of and behind it gently soften continuously according to distance and motion. No fake pores or uniform 8K resolution added to distant faces; retain broad, natural tonal variations such as faint redness on one cheek, uneven T-zone highlights, asymmetrical undereyes, and slight redness around the nose. For exposed skin resolved up close, retain non-repeating subtle skin tone shifts, natural redness on joints and pressure areas, and delicate shading. Render distinct reflections, edges, and details for skin, hair, fabric, metal, wood, walls, and water according to material, without uniform gloss or sharpness. Modest HDR, slight AWB variance, fine noise only in dark areas, faint HEIC compression, and localized slight hand-shake or slight framing misalignment are permitted, but no full-frame fake grain, uniform blur, or over-sharpening. Authentic as an unpolished candid moment from a personal camera roll, avoiding advertisements, gravure, fashion campaigns, studio glamour photography, cinematic color grading, or perfect symmetrical composition.

Mandatory and Excluded Representations: Each person has one head, face, torso, and anatomically connected two arms and two legs. Hands clearly show contact with their owner and props. Avoid extra people, duplicated people, face averaging, swapped faces/hair/outfits, extra or missing limbs, fused fingers, unnatural palms, hands clipping through objects, floating items, flipped left/right features, minors, childish adult portrayals, school uniforms, real persons, explicit nudity, translucent clothing, underwear-like clothing, isolated cropped body parts, readable text/logos/watermarks, anime, CG, and everyone sharing the same smile, head tilt, or gaze at the camera.

Background and Prop Clarification: Both the photographer and the three women are on Enoshima Island itself. Taken from a rest area along the island's walking path above the rocky shore, with the open sea facing away from the island in the background. Directly behind are coastal rocks connected to the foot of the same island, stone handrails, the water's surface, and the horizon. A composition showing the entire island of Enoshima or the Sea Candle on an opposite shore across the water is strictly forbidden. Do not add silhouettes of distant islands or lighthouses. Woman 3's large tote is plain solid black, same as at the meeting. Maintain the described scene, characters, expressions, actions, and outfits.

summaryTranslations.en: Photorealistic image prompt vividly capturing the natural, candid moment of three women taking a break by the seaside while exploring Enoshima, depicted with the authentic texture of a smartphone photo.

人物同一性：
女性1：架空の成人日本人女性22歳、情報工学科4年生。身長168cm、脚が長く姿勢のよい、自然で現実的なグラマラス体型。胸郭に釣り合う自然な重みと幅、現実的なウエスト、脚と釣り合う骨盤とヒップを保つ。押し上げや身体部位の強調はしない。縦長寄りのハート形の顔、高い頬骨、細い顎、軽い奥二重の横長アーモンド目、わずかに上がる目尻、高いアーチ眉、細くまっすぐな鼻とシャープな鼻先、厚みのある唇。日焼けしていない明るいニュートラル肌、本人右頬の高い位置に小さなほくろ1個。黒髪ロングレイヤーは胸下まで完全なストレート。ハニーブラウンの瞳、細い跳ね上げアイライン、コーラルベージュの唇、細い金のフープ。自信のある歯見せ笑顔が特徴だが、本シーンの指定表情を優先して同じ表情を反復しない。

女性3：架空の成人日本人女性23歳、ネイリスト。152cmの小柄で柔らかな成人体型、自然な体格、現実的な肩と胸郭、ウエスト、比例した骨盤とヒップ、成人の四肢比率。丸い小顔、大きな濃茶の垂れ目、短い平行眉、小さな鼻、柔らかな唇、明るいニュートラル肌、本人右目の下に小さなほくろ1個。艶のある黒髪セミロングの低いツインテール。ダスティピンクは下層の毛先の内側だけ、頭頂や根元は黒。成人らしいピンク系の目元で白塗りにしない。照れた閉じ口の笑みが特徴。朝は髪を結んでいる途中、帰宅後は髪をほどいた状態という指定アレンジを適用する。未成年・制服・コスプレにしない。
3人の顔、年齢、髪、体型、ほくろ、衣装、持ち物を混ぜない。3人とも首を傾けて笑う同じポーズにしない。小柄な女性3を子供にしない。記述した顔・体格を維持し、広告的な表面加工はしない。

場面：江ノ島の島歩き
江ノ島の島内、坂道を歩いた先の海を望む休憩場所。石の縁や植栽、奥の海が背景。観光客に頼んだ写真が、3人のポーズがそろう前に撮れた瞬間。左女性1は片腕を伸ばして奥の景色を指さし、口を開いて友達へ話す。中央女性2は片手に持った無地の蓋付き冷たい飲み物を右の女性3へ勧め、相手を見る柔らかな表情。女性3はまだ受け取らず、両手を大きなトートの持ち手に添え、頬を少し膨らませながら息を整えている。頭の角度と視線は3人で異なる。スマホ標準1倍、撮影者は約2m、胸の高さ、腰上中心で手と飲み物まで写す。3人はほぼ同じ奥行き、中央女性2の顔付近にAF。昼の自然光、風が髪や布を少し動かす。遠景は柔らかく、文字や余分な主要人物は描かない。

横長3:2、一続きの写真1枚。3人が同じ空間に一緒にいる。分割・コラージュ・枠・名前・文字はない。主役は女性1・女性2・女性3の計3人だけ。
